name: Flyte Golf
address: Unit 1A, Marina Commercial Park, Ballintemple, Cork, T12 WY83

booking.howItWorks: Book bays online. For group events and private or corporate hire, send an enquiry by form or email to info@flytegolf.ie. Flyte Golf replies within one business day with a tailored proposal.

packages.name: Bay Session (hourly)
packages.description: Per bay. Up to 4 players, and the rate stays the same whatever the group size. Includes all 400+ courses, full TrackMan data, driving range and skills game modes. 60 min €60, 90 min €90 (Extended Play), 120 min €120 (Full Session).

packages.name: Quick Hit (30 minutes)
packages.description: 30 minutes per bay. Good for a warm-up, a practice drill or a quick solo session. Up to 4 players.

packages.name: Private Hire – Group & Corporate Events
packages.description: Exclusive hire of 1 bay or all 5 for corporate days, birthdays, stag & hen parties, golf societies, client entertainment and schools. Custom competitions and catering options are available. Pricing comes in a tailored proposal.
includes: Exclusive bay or full venue access

faq.q: How many players can use one bay?
faq.a: Bring up to 4 players. The rate stays the same regardless of group size.

faq.q: How big a group can you take?
faq.a: Up to 20 guests for full venue hire, all 5 bays. Custom formats available.
Parking available on-site. Easy public transport access.
No golf experience needed. TrackMan technology levels the playing field, so first-timers compete with seasoned golfers from minute one.

faq.q: Can we add food and drinks?
faq.a: Add food and drinks packages to your event. We'll coordinate catering to suit your group size, duration, and budget.
Monthly €199/month: 2 hrs Mon–Fri, 10am–7pm, cancel anytime. Annual €1,399/year: 2 hrs, 7 days/wk, 10am–7pm.

faq.q: How quickly do you reply to enquiries?
faq.a: We'll respond within one business day.
